Kuparinen, K. and Vakkilainen, E. (2017). Green pulp mill: Renewable alternatives to fossil fuels in lime kiln operations. BioResources 12(2), 4031-4048.

Reference mill: 1.5 Mt/yr bleached eucalyptus kraft pulp, South America. Loaded: investment (Table 2) for the gasifier, lignin-separation and electrolyser concepts with their outputs (Table 3) and the common economic assumptions (20 yr, 10%, 5% O&M, 8400 h/yr). The gasifier cost is the fuel-supply add-on to an existing kiln (incremental; the kiln is not costed), so it waits for a host kiln cost. Not loaded: the torrefied-biomass and pulverized-wood concepts (fuel preparation only, no archetype), fuel prices, sellable-power changes.
(1) No currency year. (2) The hydrogen concept covers only 72% of kiln energy, so its cost is not comparable with the sole-fuel concepts.
